title: Not Impressed
text: Not Impressed. This will cut cheese fine.  Try anything harder like vegetables or fruits (tomato in my case) or meat, and it does absolutely nothing.  The most I could do was make some straight marks for cutting with a knife.  If all you want is uniform slices of cheese, this works fine.  Otherwise, look elsewhere.

product_metadata.title: NVTED Luncheon Meat Slicer, Boiled Egg Fruit Soft Cheese Slicer Cutter, Stainless Steel Wires, Cuts 10 Slices (White)
features: Designed with 10 cutting stainless steel wire, Easily cut 11 slices at a time, all equal in size, for a nice presentation and even cooking.
Made of sturdy, BPA free ABS, resist heat of temperatures up to 230F (110C), Slice hotter food items with no fear.
Easy to use, just simply place the food item in place and push down the bar until completely sliced.
Works equally well for boiled egg, luncheon meat, peeled pitaya, peeled Kiwi, ham etc.
Help you quickily prepare mouthwatering salads, sandwiches and platters,dishwasher safe for easy clean up.
